🇷🇺 🇪🇺 Schengen visas and military service: European Commission proposes tougher checks on Russian applicants According to a newly published European Commission document, Brussels has drawn up recommendations for additional scrutiny of Russian citizens applying for short-stay Schengen visas. The proposed measures would see EU member states refuse entry to individuals who currently serve, or have served, in the Russian armed forces since the start of the military operation in Ukraine. Standard visa applications could also be subjected to more extensive security checks. Russian applicants may be required to submit a military ID, complete an additional questionnaire detailing their military service, and sign a declaration confirming the accuracy of the information provided. Consulates and border authorities are also being encouraged to conduct personal interviews, systematically cross-check applicants’ fingerprints against the Schengen Information System (SIS), and record all entry refusals in the relevant databases. The European Commission stresses that the document consists of recommendations rather than legally binding rules, with individual EU member states retaining final authority over visa decisions. 🔴 @DDGeopolitics

Fwd from @ #Summary for the morning of November 24, 2026 ▪️ Peskov confirmed preparations for another round of trilateral talks between Russia, the USA and Ukraine. Abu Dhabi is being considered as the main venue, but the exact date of the meeting has not yet been agreed upon. Meanwhile, NATO Secretary General Rutte, speaking in Berlin at a session of the alliance's Parliamentary Assembly, called for preparing not only the armed forces but also the civilian population, enterprises, hospitals, transport and utilities for a possible war. NATO intends to maintain the scale of military support for Ukraine in 2027 as well. ▪️ Kyiv officially took responsibility for attacks on Russian ships and vessels in the Mediterranean Sea. Zelensky announced the sinking of the corvette «Mercury» in the area of Libyan Benghazi and the damage to the Russian cargo ship MV Angara. The SBU published footage of the strikes. The authorities of eastern Libya appealed to the UN to investigate the circumstances of the attack. ▪️ In the Baltic Sea, following an attack on the cargo ship Sparta II, Estonian Prime Minister Kristen Michal stated that one should be prepared for a repeat of such incidents. The damaged vessel was removed from Finnish territorial waters, shipping restrictions have been lifted. All 16 crew members were rescued. ▪️ Overnight, the AFU again organized a raid on Moscow; by morning, 20 drones were shot down. ▪️ Yesterday, the severe consequences of the previous mass enemy raid became known. In Perm Krai , one person was killed, two more received shrapnel wounds, and several objects at industrial sites were damaged. In Rostov Region , following the attack, the Novoshakhtinsk oil refinery suspended operations , and a fire broke out in the Krasnosulinsky District. In Tatarstan , oil storage tanks near Almetyevsk were attacked again. ▪️ The Russian Armed Forces continued strikes on Ukraine's energy, railway and port infrastructure . The Ministry of Defense reported the destruction of a 330 kV substation in Dnipropetrovsk , two locomotives near Dniprodzerzhynsk station, port facilities in Izmail and a cargo ship southwest of Odesa. In Dnipropetrovsk , the metro, trams and trolleybuses stopped due to power outages. DTEK reported damage to four energy facilities and power cuts affecting 353 thousand households in the region. In Odesa , electric transport was not operating for the third day, buses were deployed on individual routes. By Monday morning, according to the regional military administration, power supply to critical infrastructure was restored, nine of eleven major boiler rooms were operational [ ❗️ ], with approximately 79 thousand consumers remaining without heating. ▪️ Overnight, air raid sirens were sounded again in western Ukraine. Poland deployed air defense forces, and an air raid alert was declared in the eastern part of the country. Polish military command reported a brief violation of airspace by a Russian drone, which, after circling, flew back to Ukraine. ▪️ In Bryansk Region on November 23, one civilian was killed and at least five people were wounded.

Одним из самых действенных методов борьбы на море с хохлом и его вассалами ( ЕС), является выдача каперских свидетельств. Конечно сейчас это будет выглядеть не так, как во времена англо-испанских и англо-французских войн, но передача части войны на море в руки так назовем добровольцев (как это уже происходит на земле), может дать массу преимуществ. Флот может и дальше ходить в красивой форме с кортиками, при этом забывая выставить боновое заграждение у причала с боевым кораблем, а «морские БАРСы» на приобретенных за свой и за счет спонсоров БЭКах и прочих может не таких красивых, но действенных посудинах, атаковать врага и его сателлитов везде, где того требует обстановка, но не совсем удобно использовать регулярный ВМФ. Вот тогда и поглядим, как наши официальные лица будут с улыбкой на лице рассказывать жалующимся на действия современных ушкуйников еврокуколдам, что Россия тут не причем. Ящик Пандоры открыли не мы, но грех не воспользоваться уже отпертым сундуком.
